title: Design System: Remote Support Operate Console

stat.purpose: Single primary number per stat card, indigo when it's the card's headline metric, tabular figures always.

label.purpose: Stat-card labels, table column headers, badges.

shadows.name: elevated
shadows.purpose: Dialogs and open dropdown/listbox panels (light theme).

shadows.name: elevated-dark
shadows.purpose: Dialogs and open dropdown/listbox panels (dark theme).

shadows.name: elevated-strong
shadows.purpose: Reserved higher-emphasis overlay token; defined but not yet exercised beyond Panel.

motion.name: rail-slide
motion.purpose: Off-canvas nav drawer slide-in/out below md.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover/active state changes on buttons, nav items, table rows.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single pill-shaped primary commit action per screen (Approve, Send Invoice, Submit Request).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #533afd; color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: InterVariable, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4730e0; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #3a24bd; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #533afd; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: rgba(83,58,253,0.4); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Default non-primary commit action; hairline border, 8px radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #0b1220; border: 1px solid #d1d6e2; border-radius: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: InterVariable, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f6f7fb; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #533afd; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Pill-shaped tone badge with leading dot; tone driven by centralized status maps, six semantic tones.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 20px; font-family: InterVariable, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-badge-success { background: #e4f5ed; color: #0f7a53; } .ds-badge-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #0f7a53; }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Dashboard-only hero metric card; primary number in indigo with tabular figures, the deliberate exception to the hero-metric-template ban elsewhere.
components.html: Pending approvals12Oldest 6 days
components.css: .ds-stat-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #e3e6ee; border-radius: 12px; background: #ffffff; font-family: InterVariable, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-stat-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: #5c6b8e; } .ds-stat-value { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.15; color: #533afd; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-stat-meta { font-size: 13px; color: #5c6b8e; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat hairline-bordered surface at rest, no shadow.

components.name: Search Input
components.description: 8px-radius text input with leading inline SVG search icon; border shifts to primary on focus.
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; width: 100%; max-width: 320px; } .ds-search-icon { position: absolute; left: 12px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 16px; height: 16px; color: #8390af; pointer-events: none; } .ds-search-input { height: 36px; width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d6e2; background: #ffffff; padding: 0 12px 0 36px; font-size: 14px; color: #0b1220; font-family: InterVariable, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #533afd; } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color: #5c6b8e; }

components.name: Nav Rail Item
components.description: Left-rail navigation row; active state uses the soft-indigo tone on icon and label, matching selection language app-wide.
components.html: Dashboard
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: InterVariable, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #45506a; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #f6f7fb; color: #0b1220; } .ds-nav-item-active { background: #edebff; color: #4730e0; } .ds-nav-icon { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Contract Switcher
components.description: Signature component: a dropdown (never a tab) scoping Requests/Fleet/Invoices to one Contract at a time; open panel matches the elevated overlay + soft-indigo selection language.
components.css: .ds-switcher-trigger { display: inline-flex; min-width: 220px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d6e2; background: #ffffff; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; color: #0b1220; font-family: InterVariable, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-switcher-trigger:hover { background: #f6f7fb; } .ds-switcher-chevron { width: 16px; height: 16px; color: #5c6b8e; }

narrative.overview:
This is an internal, invoice-heavy Operate tool for three roles (Manager, Agent, Client Tester) sharing one tenant. Its visual world is code-led and pinned against Stripe's console register, adapted — not copied — into a Restrained internal-tool key: Stripe's own marketing gradient-mesh and editorial color range never shipped here; what carried over is the discipline of a near-white canvas, deep-navy ink, one electric-indigo accent held in reserve, and hairline-bordered flat surfaces that let numbers and status do the talking. All three surfaces (Manager Console, Agent Console, Client Portal) share one shell, one component vocabulary and one token set; only navigation items and page composition differ per role, per each surface's direction contract.

The system refuses the generic entity-list-of-lists admin template and the marketing-style welcome dashboard. Each surface leads with money and status (pending approvals, billed/payout totals, open Requests, invoice state) ahead of raw CRUD tables. Dashboard stat cards are a deliberate, brief-earned exception to an hero-metric-template ban elsewhere in the system — confined to the dashboard, not proliferated onto every page.
keyCharacteristics: Near-white / near-black canvas with deep-navy ink; one electric-indigo accent (#533afd light / #6c5cec dark) reserved for primary stat numbers, current selection and primary actions.
Flat hairline-bordered surfaces at rest; soft shadow appears only on elevated overlays (dialogs, dropdown panels).
Self-hosted Inter variable font end to end; tabular figures on every monetary and numeric value via the .tnum utility.
Compact 8px-radius controls everywhere; true pill shape reserved for the single primary commit action per screen (Approve, Send Invoice, Submit Request).
One shared left rail (240px, off-canvas drawer below md) and top bar across all three surfaces; only the nav item list and page content vary by role.
Custom stroke-based SVG icon set (24px grid, 1.75 stroke, round caps) — no icon fonts, no emoji.

rules.name: The Reserved Indigo Rule
rules.body: Indigo appears in exactly three roles per screen — the primary stat number, current selection/active nav, and the one pill-shaped primary action — never as a decorative fill, header rule, or secondary accent. Its rarity is the point of the "financial control room" register.

rules.name: The Two-Border-Tokens Rule
rules.body: Every border in the system draws from hairline or hairline-strong only; no ad hoc border colors.

rules.name: The Tabular Everywhere Rule
rules.body: Every monetary or numeric value (Money, stat-card values) carries font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums via the shared .tnum utility — no exceptions, so columns of numbers always align.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat (hairline border only) at rest. Shadow is reserved for the overlay z-layer, never applied to inline cards or table rows.

rules.name: The Pill-Is-Primary Rule
rules.body: Full-pill radius signals "the one primary action on this screen" (or a status badge). Any other control — including a "row" action styled with the soft-indigo tone — stays at the 8px control radius. A screen with two pill buttons is a defect, not a variant.

dos: Do reserve indigo for exactly the primary stat number, current selection, and the one pill primary-action per screen.
Do apply .tnum tabular figures to every monetary and numeric display value.
Do use the 8px control radius for every button, input, and row element except the single primary pill action.
Do keep the nav rail width, item styling, and active-state treatment identical across Manager, Agent and Client surfaces — only the item list changes per role.
Do use a dropdown, never a tab set, when a screen needs Contract-scoping (Agent, Client with multiple Contracts).
Do keep shadow confined to the overlay layer (dialogs, open dropdown panels); cards and table rows stay flat.
donts: Don't apply shadow to inline cards, stat cards, or table rows — shadow signals "elevated/temporary," not "static content."
Don't add a second pill-shaped control to a screen that already has a primary action.
Don't introduce a border color outside the hairline/hairline-strong tokens.
Don't use icon fonts, emoji, or a second icon library alongside the custom stroke-based SVG set.
Don't surface a draft invoice to the Client Portal — invoice visibility rules are a product constraint the visual system must respect, not a styling choice to route around.
